title: Mexican Eggplant Curry
description: A fusion of Indian and Mexican flavors, this eggplant curry is a game-changer for vegetarians. It's a flavorful and nutritious dish that's perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: eggplantlicious
ingredients.notes: Slice the eggplant into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: paneer
ingredients.notes: Cubed paneer works best in this recipe

ingredients.name: curry
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade curry powder

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: Chop the onion and sauté it before adding the eggplant

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic and add it with the onion

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.notes: Chop the tomatoes and add them with the curry powder

ingredients.name: cumin
ingredients.notes: Add cumin powder for extra flavor

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.notes: Add coriander powder for extra flavor

ingredients.name: chili powder
ingredients.notes: Add chili powder for a spicy kick

ingredients.name: oil
ingredients.notes: Use any oil of your choice for frying

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until it's translucent.
Add minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the sliced eggplant and cook until it's tender.
Add the cubed paneer and cook until it's lightly browned.
Add the curry powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, and chili powder.
Mix well and add the chopped tomatoes.
Let the mixture simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the sauce thickens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
